title: What Would You Notice If the Moon Vanished?
summary: The Moon does more than light up the night. Here is what would change on Earth if it suddenly disappeared.

beats.text: Tonight you look up, and the Moon is gone. What happens to the oceans? Pause and guess!
First, nights get much darker. Only stars and city lights are left.
Time's up. What happens to the oceans?
beats.reveal: The tides shrink! Most of their pull comes from the Moon.

beats.text: The Sun still pulls on the water, so tides stay, just weaker.
Over millions of years, Earth's tilt could also wobble more, without the Moon to steady it.
Bonus fact: the Moon is drifting away from us, about four centimetres every year.

visual.text: The Moon drifts about 3.8 cm farther from Earth every year.
